parsed.rationale: All 11 members are unnamed extensions (name is empty string) on `EnvironmentValues` spread across 5 distinct packages — `AppServices`, `Playback`, `WXUI`, `Wallpaper`, and `PlayerHeaderView`. Extending `EnvironmentValues` in the file that declares the corresponding environment key is the canonical SwiftUI pattern; each extension adds domain-specific keys (e.g., `PlaylistServiceEnvironment.swift`, `AccentColorEnvironment.swift`, `RadioPlayerControllerEnvironment.swift`) that are intentionally scoped to their owning package. Consolidating them would either force undesirable cross-package dependencies or require moving unrelated domain logic into a single file, both of which would worsen cohesion. The structural collision is purely coincidental — all files extend the same SwiftUI type but encode entirely unrelated domain concepts.
